instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\inspect_me.dxf. Import inspect_me.dxf. Draw an inspection coupon outline (0,0)-(150,100), add two horizontal SLOT rectangular outlines with opposite corners (30,60)-(70,72) and (85,60)-(125,72), add four diameter 8 datum holes at the corners (15,15), (135,15), (15,85), and (135,85), and add text ACAD-22. Use OUTLINE for the coupon outline, SLOT for slot rectangles, HOLE for datum holes, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
